Our Process

Business first.
Digital solution second.

Every Chambre 17 project begins by understanding the business behind the screen.

01 — Understand

We start with your business.

We learn how your business works, who your customers are, what you need and what you want to achieve.

02 — Design & Build

We turn the idea into a digital experience.

We define the structure, design the experience and build the solution around what your business actually needs.

03 — Review

We review it together.

You experience the solution, give feedback and we refine the details together before launch.

04 — Launch

We put it live.

We test, optimize and launch the final experience across devices.

05 — Manage

We stay with it.

After launch, we can manage, maintain and continuously improve your digital solution as your business evolves.

Monthly Management

Launch is not the end.

Your website can stay maintained, updated and improved every month.

About Us

We understand business before we design the website.

Chambre 17 is an independent digital studio based in La Rochelle, built on experience across business, retail, digital marketing, data, AI, e-commerce and graphic design.

Our approach is simple: we don't start with a template. We start by understanding your business — your customers, your goals and what your website actually needs to achieve.

Then we design and build around it.

Design. Business. Technology.All in one room.
